operations.description: INSPIRE shows the indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales.
Current download page states publication on 5 July 2026.
New files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
Polygon downloads are organised by local authority.
INSPIRE files are published as GML.
A GIS is required to view the downloaded polygons.
The polygons and attributes are reusable under the Open Government Licence.
INSPIRE polygons do not establish the legal extent of a registered title.
Legal title extent must be identified from the individual title plan.
A single registered title may contain several separate polygons.
Each separate polygon has its own Land Registry INSPIRE ID.
A missing INSPIRE ID may indicate unregistered land, leasehold, or another tenure excluded from INSPIRE.
Official metadata identifies the LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model at 1 metre resolution.
Input LIDAR surveys are stated as ±15 cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
The coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700.
A public WCS service is listed for the 1 m DTM.
A WMS preview service is listed for the 1 m DTM.
A WMTS service is listed for the 1 m DTM.
An OGC API Features service is listed.
Official metadata provides survey-data download access.
Official metadata provides survey coverage metadata access.
The dataset publisher is the Environment Agency.
OS Terrain 50 is a terrain model of Great Britain.
The grid uses 50 metre post spacing.
Contours are supplied at 10 metre intervals.
The product is updated annually.
The product is marked free to use for everyone.
Listed formats include ASCII grid, Shapefile, GeoPackage, GML and Vector Tiles.
